21 (808ed65, review follow-up) Activity ledger, label of a recorded_offline entry (ActivityScreen LABEL): 'Payment recorded' -> 'Investment recorded'. Kind, tone and order unchanged; matches 'Recorded investments' (fund receipts list), 'Investment added' (investment email subject) and the What's new notes.
